thread:
omar: quick check — who owns telemetry for early retries vs hedging at the proxy/gateway boundary? we have blind spots where retries are emitted by gateway but counted by edge.
sasha: short answer: right now it's split. gateway emits a header `X-RW-Retry-Phase` but we don't consistently emit parent spans/metrics.
liam: examples of the gaps?
sasha: two main ones: 1) early fast retries (client vs gateway) — gateway triggers, upstream edge may mark them as aborts and we lose retry attribution. 2) hedging fallback: both sides may increment retry counters and we double-count.
jess: this causes billing/SLAs and also mis-leads SLO dashboards. we need a single canonical span and a small header to carry retry ownership + id.
tara: propose header: `X-Redwood-Retry-Id` and `X-Redwood-Retry-Origin: gateway|edge|client`. gateway sets ID on first retry attempt; edge should honor and not re-assign. also add metric labels: retry_id, origin, outcome.
omar: sounds reasonable. what about sampling? we can't trace every token.
sasha: sample spans but always emit counters with labels. metric names: `proxy.retry.invocations`, `proxy.retry.hedge_count`, `proxy.retry.mismatch` with tag origin.
liam: implementation notes: 1) gateway: generate UUID for retry attempts, attach header for any retry/hedge; 2) edge: if header present, increment metric with that id and set tracing span parent_id = header; do not create new retry-id. If absent, edge generates its own and marks origin=edge.
jess: add enforcement: if edge sees header but also sees different retry semantics (e.g., hedged duplicate) it should emit `proxy.retry.mismatch` counter for ops to debug.
infra-bot: deploy: rollout of gateway header support in canary env started by @ci at 1751240000 :rocket:
omar: action items: 1) jess to add metrics + mismatch counters (ETA 2d). 2) liam to update edge to consume `X-Redwood-Retry-Id` and opt-out of reassign (ETA 5d). 3) sasha to add dashboard panels showing origin breakdown and a sample rate knob. 4) tara to add header spec to API gateway contract doc and ping security for header whitelist. 5) we will run a 2-week canary and then flip in prod. anyone object?
liam: no objections. I'll file a PR draft today.
jess: +1. will stub metrics in observability repo.
tara: I'll add header spec to the API gateway contract doc and ping security for header whitelist.
omar: nice. thanks — i'll put this in the follow-up RFC and link the PRs. :thumbsup:
